result.summary: This residential intersection features a sidewalk on one side but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and absence of traffic control signs at the immediate junction may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a pedestrian-oriented area.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right terminates at a vertical curb without a ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner where the sidewalk meets the asphalt

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing markings, which fails to alert drivers to pedestrian presence and does not provide a clear path for walkers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the intersection

hazards.name: Privacy blur obstruction
hazards.description: A large blurred area in the background obscures potential hazards or oncoming traffic further down the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right background

interventions.title: Install ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped ramps with tactile warning pads at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure clear sightlines by restricting parking near the intersection corners.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with minimal pedestrian infrastructure. While a narrow paved walkway exists, it lacks separation from the roadway, is obstructed by overhanging vegetation, and lacks standard safety features like marked crossings or lighting.

hazards.name: Vegetation Obstruction
hazards.description: Low-hanging tree branches and dense foliage significantly narrow the usable walkway and block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, overhanging the narrow paved path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The walkway is extremely narrow and flush with the roadway, providing no physical or vertical buffer for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom right foreground along the edge of the road.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The asphalt walkway is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom right corner.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Install a standard-width concrete sidewalk with a landscaped buffer or curb to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune overhanging trees to a minimum height of 8 feet to clear the pedestrian path and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve safety and visibility during dawn, dusk, and nighttime.

result.summary: The residential environment is characterized by a complete lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with motor vehicles, and sightlines at the nearby intersection are partially obscured by mature trees and residential fencing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk directly in the travel lane, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edges of the roadway throughout the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions at Intersection
hazards.description: Mature trees and a wooden fence on the corner may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: The right side of the roadway leading up to the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.
